verdict.rationale: A public API is a fair question for a government corporate registry, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only human-facing channels: the Online Filing Centre web interface and PDF forms by email or mail. The probe explicitly found that the registry documents no transactional API on any surface checked. The keyless CKAN API that answered belongs to the separate open.canada.ca open-data portal, and nothing shows it can drive Corporations Canada filings.
